name: spacefarer
description: An Elite-inspired procedural space trading game that runs in the browser with a backend galaxy service.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @spacefarer/shared && npm run build --workspace @spacefarer/backend && npm run build --workspace @spacefarer/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @spacefarer/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @spacefarer/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace @spacefarer/frontend
